note: Dependency graph across the wall. `kind` is how the edge is evidenced: code = declared in a manifest and verifiable; contract = a shared format or protocol with no code dependency; planned = intended, not yet built. Tier is computed by build.py as the longest dependency chain starting at a node, so every poster sits above everything it depends on.

edges.why: consumes swift-http-files as a remote SPM package
ContentFormats depends on Base256 and re-exports it
HttpAws carries the SigV4 dependency alone
implements the format the spec defines
RequestLink encoding shared with the app; universal links resolve into it
becomes the req CLI's page once that ships
every probe anchor must resolve to a statement in the spec
grades req as one of seven lanes, from source
consumes the extracted codec; no in-app copy remains
binary outputs travel through Shortcuts as Base256 text
the authenticated lane assumes a role through iam.pub

isolated.glass: no dependency on anything else in the tree
isolated.date: a single edge function; nothing here depends on it
isolated.hmac: a single edge function; exposes the chain SigV4 derives
